import anyio
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import PlainTextResponse
from starlette.routing import Mount, Route, Router
from starlette.testclient import TestClient

ran = []

async def ep(request: Request):
    ran.append(1)
    return PlainTextResponse(str(len(await request.body())))

def test_mount_cl_raise_and_lower():
    inner = Router(routes=[Route("/", ep, methods=["POST"], max_body_size=100)])
    app = Starlette(routes=[Mount("/m", app=inner), Mount("/n", routes=[Route("/", ep, methods=["POST"])], max_body_size=5)], max_body_size=5)
    c = TestClient(app)
    assert c.post("/m/", content=b"x" * 50).text == "50"
    ran.clear()
    assert c.post("/n/", content=b"x" * 10).status_code == 413
    assert ran == []

def test_nested_mount_cl():
    app = Starlette(routes=[Mount("/a", routes=[Mount("/b", routes=[Route("/", ep, methods=["POST"])], max_body_size=100)])], max_body_size=5)
    assert TestClient(app).post("/a/b/", content=b"x" * 50).text == "50"
    ran.clear()
    app = Starlette(routes=[Mount("/a", routes=[Mount("/b", routes=[Route("/", ep, methods=["POST"])], max_body_size=5)], max_body_size=100)])
    assert TestClient(app).post("/a/b/", content=b"x" * 50).status_code == 413
    assert ran == []

findings.text: No test combines a declared Content-Length with an inner Mount/Router limit that raises or lowers the app limit (only route-level fail-fast is tested).
test_response_started_in_starlette_streaming asserts only `status in (200, 413)`, so it is a weak check of the already-started-response path inside Starlette.
Mount.handle's getattr-based router sniffing to choose check_content_length is convoluted; a mounted Starlette/Router could always defer the check.
